verdict.rationale: Digits is an AI-native accounting SaaS with a public API, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack documents no Digits CLI, only adjacent surfaces: the Connect API, an OpenAPI spec with third-party codegen, and a hosted MCP server. The only command-line mention, 'claude mcp add', is Claude Code's CLI, not one shipped by Digits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
